title: delta-0 activate is a no-op on the palette + scale rows: touch taps, Enter, and pad A can never change palette or UI scale
detail: cycle_*(cur, 0) = cur (test-pinned). Every delta-0 path — touch row tap (settings_click), keyboard Enter, pad A — is a no-op on PALETTE and SCALE rows. Touch has no ±1 path, so touch-only players cannot change palette/scale at all; the B2 fix regressed to fully dead, contradicting the intent doc 'delta 0 = cycle/next' and the 'delta-0 tap advances' comment.
recommended_fix: Normalize delta 0 to +1 before cycling (step := delta; if step == 0 { step = 1 }) in effect_settings_adjust, and re-pin the cycle_scale(0,0) test to the advance semantic.

title: QoS manual editor: r2 scaled the nudge rects but not the lane label/weight x — the weight value draws ON the minus button at x1.25/x1.50
evidence:
qos_nudge_rect: 	x := rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X + 8 + lane * 96) ... draw loop: 	for lane in 0..<3 {
		x := QOS_PANEL_X + 8 + lane * 96
		y := qos_row_y(&app.view, 6 + i32(len(app.cat.packet_types)))
		draw_text(app, short[lane], i32(x), y + rnd.hud(&app.view, 4), rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), cols[lane]) ... 		draw_text(app, wv, i32(x + 44), y + 4, 14, p.ink)
detail: Born in r2 (B5 rework scaled only the rects). At x1.50 lane 0: minus button spans x 60..90 while the unscaled weight text draws at 64..85, y+4 vs button y+5 — text-on-text. At x1.25 minus spans 50..75, weight at 64..78. Lane 1's weight (160..181) also clips lane 0's plus button (138..168). The value being edited is illegible at both scaled steps.
recommended_fix: Scale the draw loop's x and the wv offset/font through hud()/hud_f() (same expression as qos_nudge_rect) so labels, values, and buttons stay column-aligned at every step.

title: S is a dead key while the panel is open with a pipe selected (opened via chip tap or pad Y)
detail: The sel_pipe<0 collection gate ignores panel_open. Click a pipe, then open the panel via the settings chip or pad Y: S is neither collected (no Toggle_Settings) nor phase-2'd (panel_open blocks it) — the documented 'S / tap chip to close' key silently no-ops. Esc/chip still work, so recoverable.
recommended_fix: Collect S when inp.panel_open regardless of sel_pipe (panel-open S can never reach Set_Lane — phase-2 is blocked while open).

title: QoS lane-split bar + queue-depth label left unscaled while their rows/labels scale in r2 — draw mismatch inside the scaled panel
detail: r2 scaled the split label (hud x/offset/font) and the row pitch, but the proportion bar keeps unscaled x=130, 8px height, max 150px width inside a 450px panel at x1.50, overlapping the now-23px label text above it; the queue-depth label keeps unscaled x/offset/font on a scaled row. Same single-source rule the rest of the panel now follows.
recommended_fix: Route the bar x/height/width basis (QOS_PANEL_W-150, 118, 7, 8) and the depth-label offsets/font through hud()/hud_f().

title: still present since round 1: popover height/text unscaled — at x1.50 the scaled demolish button rides up over the pipe popover's title
detail: popover_rect scales width/offsets but takes h raw (64 for pipes); the r2 demolish_button_rect scales its insets, so at x1.50 the button top = pop.y+64-54 = pop.y+10 with height 39, covering the title drawn at pop.y+8..23 (button drawn after). Node popover (h=92) clears. Draw+hit stay consistent; the pixels overlap.
recommended_fix: Scale the popover heights (hud_f on POPOVER_H_*) and the popover text sizes, or clamp the button below the title line.

title: still present since round 1: panel opened while placement is armed (pad Y) — mouse left-press skips on_ui_press (placing gate), so panel rows/chip are unclickable until Esc
detail: With placing_eff >= 0 the ui-press hook never runs, and the new panel-open branch then suppresses everything else — a mouse press on a panel row or the chip evaporates. Touch is unaffected (its panel branch calls on_ui_press directly); keyboard arrows/Esc work. Mixed pad+mouse state only.
recommended_fix: While panel_open, call on_ui_press regardless of placing_eff (the modal owns the surface).

title: node-health card width scales (hud) but there is still no right-edge x clamp — at x1.50 a right-edge node's card overflows the window
detail: The diff clamps y only. The card now draws 1.5x wider from the same unclamped anchor x, so nodes near the right map edge push the scaled card off-screen at the knob steps whose AC is chrome legibility. Pre-existing gap, amplified by the r2 width scaling.
recommended_fix: Mirror the y clamp: if x + hud(v, NODE_HEALTH_CARD_W) > v.win_w { x = v.win_w - hud(v, NODE_HEALTH_CARD_W) }.
